content: SMS marketing carries real compliance weight even for small business: TCPA-style regimes require opt-in consent, opt-out (STOP) handling, and a suppression/do-not-contact list; CAN-SPAM-style rules require unsubscribe links in bulk email. These are table-stakes guardrails for the bulk messaging feature, not just nice-to-have -- exact PH-specific rules need verification (Data Privacy Act RA 10173) but the pattern (consent + easy opt-out + suppression list) is safe default.
